name: optimism-sepolia

deployer.note: The key that deploys the 47 contracts and administers the escrow it deploys; fund it first (a deployment is about 0.5-1.6 ETH of gas at the chain's price). No default on a public chain.

identity8004.note: Deploys the Identity8004Stub so the world is complete on its own. Where the official ERC-8004 registry is live on this chain, switch to {"mode": "address", "address": "0x…"} before deploying, as worlds/sepolia.json does.

notes: A template: `foga world deploy --world worlds/optimism-sepolia.json --rpc <url> --out deployments/optimism-sepolia.json` deploys the full stack (mode deploy, every contract from the bundle) with FOGA_DEPLOYER_PK; the address book it writes is what `foga join --world deployments/optimism-sepolia.json` takes. One key is one address on every EVM chain, so the wallet that joined Sepolia joins here unchanged.

AID liveness windows (90 d / 365 d) and the KYA Groth16 adapter parameters (issuer set root of the upstream kya_public_v1 prover, 30 d epochs, 1 epoch grace) mirror the upstream Sepolia reference deployments so the upstream provers and resolvers work unchanged.
ARD kind URIs mirror the upstream evidence script (kind:<name>).
